items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of J.C. Higginbotham interacting with, meeting, or knowing Clarence Page. The name Clarence Page appears only in the Interviewer's questions/narration regarding Wes Helvey.

ctx.x: How did you meet Wes Helvey?
I went to visit my sister and Clarence Page who lived next door, he had a band and he heard me practice. So he told Wes Helvey about me.
